item.title: Node.js Technical Interviewer
item.description:
Dataforest шукає досвідченого Lead Node.js Engineer або Solutions Architect, який долучиться до нашої рекрутинг-команди як парт-тайм технічний інтерв'юер.
 

Ваша головна місія — проводити технічні інтерв'ю з кандидатами на позицію Senior Node.js Backend Specialist у сфері Cybersecurity, перевіряти не лише їхній hard skills стек, а й рівень самостійності та вміння працювати з вимогами.
 

Це ідеальна можливість для діючих Node.js-техлідів та архітекторів, які мають вільні кілька годин на тиждень, володіють високим рівнем англійської та хочуть монетизувати свій експертний досвід.
 

Що потрібно буде робити:

  • Скринінг CV та первинна оцінка: перевірка та відбір резюме кандидатів на відповідність кваліфікаційним вимогам.
  • Проведення співбесід (англійською мовою за можливості): Проведення 1-on-1 технічних інтерв'ю тривалістю 60 хвилин.
  • Глибока оцінка навичок:
    • Hard Skills: Node.js (5+ років досвіду), TypeScript, розробка backend-архітектури, REST/GraphQL API, бази даних (SQL/NoSQL) та бажано досвід роботи з data-intensive системами/даними.
    • Soft Skills & Autonomy: Оцінка здатності кандидата самостійно розбиратися у нечітких вимогах, формувати завдання під себе, спілкуватися з клієнтом та самостійно вести розробку.
    • English Level: Перевірка вільного володіння англійською мовою (C1 / просунутий розмовний).
  • Підготовка фідбеку: Формування розгорнутого технічного висновку (англійською або українською) із зазначенням сильних/слабких сторін та однозначної рекомендації.
  • Адаптація чек-листа: Допомога у коригуванні питань для інтерв'ю під специфіку проекта та вимоги.
     

Наші очікування від вас:

  • 8+ років практичного досвіду backend-розробки (з акцентом на Node.js / TypeScript) та поточний статус Senior / Lead Engineer / Architect.
  • Англійська мова на рівні C1 (Fluent): Оскільки інтерв'ю або їхня частина проводяться англійською, а кандидатам потрібен високий рівень мови для прямого спілкування з клієнтом.
  • Досвід роботи з великими обсягами даних / Data Engineering / Data Pipelines буде суттєвою перевагою.
  • Практичний досвід проведення технічних співбесід та оцінки Senior-інженерів.
  • Вміння проводити інтерв'ю в дружній, партнерській атмосфері та чітко аргументувати свої висновки.
     

Що ми пропонуємо:

  • Погодинна оплата: Оплата за кожне проведене інтерв'ю + підготовлений фідбек (ставка обговорюється індивідуально).
  • Гнучке навантаження: Орієнтовно від 1 до 4 інтерв'ю на тиждень (залежно від потоку кандидатів та вашого графіка).
  • Повністю віддалений формат та орієнтованість на ваш графік: Ви самі обираєте зручні слоти для проведення співбесід.
  • Мінімальна бюрократія: Пряма та оперативна співпраця з нашою рекрутинг-командою.

item.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Boosters)
item.description:
About the Role

Our promotional features team is seeking a Senior Backend Engineer. This role is focused on developing and optimizing promotional features for our gaming platforms, where performance, scalability, and cutting-edge solutions are paramount.
If you’re a product-passionate person, your mind is keen to solve deep tech engineering problems, and you have a fast "PoC first" approach with a deep sense of ownership, we would love to hear from you.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain robust backend systems for our promotional features.
  • Optimize existing systems for enhanced performance and scalability.
  • Lead technical decisions and contribute to our SaaS solutions.
  • Collaborate with distributed teams to innovate and implement new features.
  • Ensure code and architectural excellence through reviews.
  • Address complex technical challenges with innovative solutions.
  • Participating in on-call rotations within the squad to help ensure the reliability and availability of our systems.

 

Requirments

  • Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript (our primary backend stack). We’re also open to strong backend engineers from other ecosystems (e.g., Go, Java, C#, C++) who are ready to ramp up quickly.
  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming and concurrency patterns.
  • Experience building distributed systems and working with messaging and coordination tools (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS, distributed locks).
  • Experience with gRPC in production environments.
  • Solid knowledge of databases: relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL), columnar (ClickHouse), and NoSQL (DynamoDB, MongoDB).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) and Kubernetes.
  • Skilled in building and maintaining unit and end-to-end tests.
  • Proven track record of delivering production-ready solutions.
  • Experience working with large-scale microservices architectures.
  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

 

Nice to Have

  • Understanding of enterprise development patterns
  • Experienced with large-scale microservices architecture
  • Experience with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, etc.)
  • Active performance observation
  • Gambling domain experience
  • Understanding of application security and industry standards, its best practice
     

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary
  • Quarterly Bonuses
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Unlimited Paid Sick Leave
  • Remote & Flexible Working
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Financial Support for Life Events
  • Professional Development Budget
  • International Exposure
  • Regular Company Events

*Benefits may vary depending on location and contractual agreement
 

Recruitment Process

  • HR interview
  • Technical interview (with Live coding)
  • Final interview

Please take into account that sometimes the process may differ, your TA Partner will keep you updated.

item.title: Lead Backend Engineer
item.description:
Our client is looking for an experienced Lead Backend Engineer to design, build, and scale modern backend systems and cloud-native applications supporting headless and frontend applications.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role combining backend engineering, architecture, DevOps, and team leadership. You will lead a Scrum team throughout the software development lifecycle while contributing directly to backend development, cloud architecture, database and search solutions, and engineering best practices.

The role reports to the Chief Architect.

Responsibilities

Backend Engineering & Architecture

  • Lead a Scrum team throughout the SDLC, ensuring project goals are delivered within scope and timelines.
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using TypeScript, Node.js, and Python.
  • Build cloud-native and serverless applications primarily on AWS and Serverless Framework.
  • Participate in architectural design and technical strategy for modern backend and service workflows.
  • Apply distributed systems, event-driven, API-first, and microservices patterns.
  • Lead code reviews and promote maintainable engineering practices.

Database & Search

  • Design and optimize MongoDB data models, queries, indexes, and aggregation pipelines.
  • Improve database performance, scalability, and cost efficiency in high-volume environments.
  • Implement advanced search solutions using Elasticsearch, Atlas Search, Lucene-based engines, and/or vector search.
  • Support both conventional and AI-based search workflows.

AWS & Infrastructure

  • Design and operate cloud-native solutions using AWS services such as Lambda, ECS, Fargate, SQS, SNS, EventBridge, S3, and VPC.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
  • Contribute to infrastructure initiatives focused on scalability, reliability, security, performance, cost optimization, and disaster recovery.
  • Define and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing and deployment.

Reliability & Security

  • Monitor and improve the reliability, observability, and performance of distributed systems across multiple environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex system and production issues.
  • Ensure security and compliance best practices are followed across internal and external services.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional backend engineering experience building complex, production-grade systems.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Node.js, TypeScript, and Python.
  • Extensive experience with MongoDB, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, aggregation pipelines, and performance tuning.
  • Strong experience designing and operating serverless and cloud-native architectures on AWS.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with Elasticsearch, Atlas Search, Lucene-based engines, and/or vector search.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architectures, API-first design, and microservices.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of system reliability, observability, performance, security, and scalability.
  • Experience leading code reviews and promoting engineering best practices.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to lead and collaborate with engineering teams.

Nice to Have

  • AWS or related cloud certification(s).
  • Experience with AI-based search or vector search technologies.
  • Experience working with enterprise SaaS products and distributed systems.
  • Experience leading Scrum or engineering teams.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.

What We Offer

  • Competitive market salary.
  • Fully remote work.
  • Opportunity to design and scale modern backend and cloud-native systems.
  • Hands-on ownership of backend architecture and technical direction.
  • Work with modern AWS, serverless, database, and search technologies.
  • Collaboration with experienced international engineering teams.
  • Opportunity to lead a technical team while remaining hands-on.

item.title: Senior Backend Engineer
item.description:
Our partner is a leading B2B iGaming supplier delivering engaging casino content to regulated markets worldwide. Since 2012, they’ve been building high-quality gaming experiences through a modern cloud-native platform that powers hundreds of operator brands across multiple jurisdictions.

 

Their Platform Solutions team sits at the heart of that ecosystem, enabling seamless integrations between the company, operators, aggregators and platform providers.

 

Our partner is looking for a Senior Backend Developer who thrives in a deeply hands-on environment and enjoys being close to the code on a daily basis. This role is heavily focused on building, optimising, and scaling backend services in a high-load system where performance and reliability are critical.

 

You’ll be working on complex, real-time challenges at the core of their platform – improving latency, ensuring high availability, and making systems more efficient at scale. This is not a coordination-heavy role; it’s for someone who enjoys writing production code, solving tough engineering problems, and seeing the direct impact of their work.

 

Main Responsibilities

 

• Work as part of a cross-functional team owning a core product within the platform
• Design, build, and deliver new backend features end-to-end in a distributed environment
• Write high-quality, production-level code daily, contributing directly to a high-load, scalable system
• Take ownership of services handling financial transactions at scale, with a strong focus on reliability
and accuracy
• Proactively suggest and implement improvements in architecture, processes, and development
practices
• Participate in code and architectural reviews to maintain high engineering standards
• Solve complex business and technical challenges with pragmatic, efficient solutions
• Participating in on-call rotations within the squad to ensure the reliability and availability of our
systems
• Play an active role in ongoing tech transformation initiatives across the platform
• Collaborate closely with engineers, product, and other stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions
used by millions globally

 

Mandatory Requirements

 

• Solid experience with Node.js/TypeScript is ideal, but we also welcome experts in other OOP languages such as Java, Python, C++, C#, or Go.
• Strong understanding of asynchronous programming techniques
• Experience with distributed systems and messaging systems (Apache Kafka, gRPC)
• Knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL), columnar databases (ClickHouse), and
NoSQL technologies (DynamoDB, MongoDB)
• Skilled in developing and maintaining end-to-end and unit tests
• Proven track record of developing production-ready solutions
• Degree in Computer Science or related field

 

Nice to Have


• Experience with large-scale microservices architecture.
• Good ground knowledge of Kubernetes
• Familiarity with cloud providers (especially AWS)
• Understanding of application security and industry best practices
• Understanding of enterprise development patterns
• Active performance observation
• Gambling domain experience

 

We offer

 

• Competitive Salary
• Quarterly Bonuses
• Unlimited Paid Time Off
• Unlimited Paid Sick Leave
• Remote & Flexible Working
• Private Medical Insurance
• Financial Support for Life Events
• Professional Development Budget
• International Exposure
• Regular Company Events
